This means that no great-grandfather of Reyes can be Justin, because Justin cannot fulfill both conditions simultaneously.

Therefore, the conclusion logically follows from the premises: If Justin is a great-grandfather of Reyes, he must be an uncle of Roberto and a workmate of Glenn, but we know Justin cannot be both. Hence, Justin cannot be a great-grandfather of Reyes.
